typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		SNO as decimal(18,0),
		{Site Location} as string,
		Date as date,
		{Ticket No} as decimal(18,0),
		{Customer Name} as string,
		severity as string,
		{Call Description} as string,
		Resolution as string,
		Status as string,
		{Call logged time } as string,
		{Call closure time} as string,
		{RHS Resolution Time in Min} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName,
		Fname = $FileName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		severity as string,
		Status as string,
		UploadDate as string,
		SiteLocation as string,
		FName as string,
		Date as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		CallDescription as string,
		SNO as integer,
		CallLoggedTime as string,
		RHSResolutionTimeinMin as string,
		TicketNo as integer,
		CustomerName as string,
		CallClosureTime as string,
		Resolution as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		severity,
		Status,
		UploadDate,
		SiteLocation = {Site Location},
		FName = Fname,
		Date,
		EtlUser,
		CallDescription = {Call Description},
		SNO,
		CallLoggedTime = {Call logged time },
		RHSResolutionTimeinMin = {RHS Resolution Time in Min},
		TicketNo = {Ticket No},
		CustomerName = {Customer Name},
		CallClosureTime = {Call closure time},
		Resolution),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
